package check

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

type followMockTransport struct {
	status    int
	url       string
	redirects map[string]string
}

func (m *followMockTransport) RoundTrip(req *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	if m.url == "" {
		return &http.Response{
			StatusCode: m.status,
			Status:     "200 OK",
			Body:       httptest.NewRecorder().Result().Body,
			Request:    req,
		}, nil
	}

	if next, ok := m.redirects[req.URL.String()]; ok {
		return &http.Response{
			StatusCode: http.StatusFound,
			Status:     "302 Found",
			Header:     make(http.Header),
			Body:       httptest.NewRecorder().Result().Body,
			Request:    req,
		}, nil
	}

	return &http.Response{
		StatusCode: m.status,
		Status:     "200 OK",
		Body:       httptest.NewRecorder().Result().Body,
		Request:    req,
	}, nil
}

func TestFollow(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name      string
		ctx       context.Context
		client    *http.Client
		url       string
		depth     int
		wantURL   string
		wantStat  string
		wantErr   string
		polarity  string
		covers    string
		cancel    bool
	}{
		{
			name:     "Happy path - no redirects",
			ctx:      context.Background(),
			client:   &http.Client{Transport: &followMockTransport{status: 200, url: "http://example.com/a"}},
			url:      "http://example.com/a",
			depth:    5,
			wantURL:  "http://example.com/a",
			wantStat: "200 OK",
			wantErr:  "",
			polarity: "success",
			covers:   "happy",
		},
		{
			name:     "Follow multiple redirects",
			ctx:      context.Background(),
			client:   &http.Client{Transport: &followMockTransport{redirects: map[string]string{"http://a.com": "http://b.com", "http://b.com": "http://c.com"}, status: 200, url: "http://c.com"}},
			url:      "http://a.com",
			depth:    3,
			wantURL:  "http://c.com",
			wantStat: "200 OK",
			wantErr:  "",
			polarity: "success",
			covers:   "happy",
		},
		{
			name:     "Stop at depth limit",
			ctx:      context.Background(),
			client:   &http.Client{Transport: &followMockTransport{redirects: map[string]string{"http://a.com": "http://b.com"}, status: 302, url: "http://b.com"}},
			url:      "http://a.com",
			depth:    1,
			wantURL:  "http://b.com",
			wantStat: "302 Found",
			wantErr:  "",
			polarity: "success",
			covers:   "boundary",
		},\n		{
			name:     "Error on redirect limit exceeded",
			ctx:      context.Background(),
			client:   &http.Client{Transport: &followMockTransport{redirects: map[string]string{"http://a.com": "http://b.com", "http://b.com": "http://c.com"}, status: 302, url: "http://c.com"}},
			url:      "http://a.com",
			depth:    1,
			wantURL:  "",
			wantStat: "",
			wantErr:  "too many redirects",
			polarity: "negative",
			covers:   "boundary",
		},
		{
			name:     "Context timeout",
			ctx:      context.Background(),
			client:   &http.Client{Transport: &followMockTransport{status: 200, url: "http://a.com"}},
			url:      "http://a.com",
			depth:    5,
			wantURL:  "",
			wantStat: "",
			wantErr:  "context canceled",
			polarity: "negative",
			covers:   "boundary",
			cancel:  true,
		},\n		{
			name:     "Empty URL",
			ctx:      context.Background(),
			client:   &http.Client{},
			url:      "",
			depth:    5,
			wantURL:  "",
			wantStat: "",
			wantErr:  "invalid URL",
			polarity: "negative",
			covers:   "input:url",
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(tt.ctx)
			defer cancel()
			if tt.cancel {
				cancel()
			}

			gotURL, gotStat, gotErr := follow(ctx, tt.client, tt.url, tt.depth)
			if gotURL != tt.wantURL {
				t.Errorf("gotURL = %q, want %q", gotURL, tt.wantURL)
			}
			if gotStat != tt.wantStat {
				t.Errorf("gotStat = %q, want %q", gotStat, tt.wantStat)
			}
			if gotErr != tt.wantErr {
				t.Errorf("gotErr = %q, want %q", gotErr, tt.wantErr)
			}
		})
	}
}
